notes: Version 1.8 aligns the statements that consume ENI's colour reading with ENI version 2.9. A colour projection onto colour-neutral observables is non-injective under the premises of ENI Corollary 6; colour neutrality is the premise of that statement, not its consequence, so the non-observability of free colour is not derived. No colour stratum is supplied by the programme. The constituent row, the output-table row (which no longer cites O31 or O32 as support) and the open-deliverables item are reworded accordingly, with status conditional. No other statement is changed.
